FAQs

Electrical Questions, Answered

What customers ask before they ring, answered by Scott and the team.

Quotes and Timing The Work About Us

Quotes and Timing

Do you provide free quotations?

Yes. Quotes are free and there's no obligation. Call 07813 626998 or send us the details.

How quickly can you do the job?

It depends on the size of the premises and the work. Minor repairs and maintenance can often be done in a few hours, larger repairs or upgrades take a day or more, and an office lighting upgrade takes about 30 minutes per light.

Can you give us ideas?

Yes. Scott designed the high bay lighting for a warehouse rewire in RH10, and customers on Google mention him suggesting more efficient and cost effective alternatives that saved them money. Lighting design and installation.

The Work

Do you install home EV chargers?

Yes. We supply, install, test and certificate EV chargers for homes and businesses, and EV charger installation is one of the team's qualifications. EV charger installation.

Can you replace my old fuseboard or consumer unit?

Yes, it's one of the three things we do most. Scott's view is that other firms go wrong by fitting cheap fuseboards. The brands we work with include Hager, Schneider Electric, Eaton, ABB, MK Electric and Crabtree. Rewires and fuseboards.

Can you provide electrical certification after a job is completed?

Yes. Our installations are tested and given the right certificate, and our NAPIT certificate lets us self-certify electrical installations in homes under the Building Regulations.

Can you carry out electrical work outside normal business hours?

Yes, where the job needs it. Commercial EICRs are usually done out of hours, because the power has to go off. Our normal hours are 7am to 7pm. EICRs and testing.

We have an electrical problem. Can you help?

Yes. We find and fix faults, including emergency call outs, such as the one we answered for a shop on London Road in East Grinstead. A Checkatrade customer in RH10 wrote that our engineer identified and solved the issue very quickly.

How long does a domestic EICR take?

Usually about 1 to 4 hours, depending on the size of the property, the number of circuits and the condition of the installation. We do them in working hours. EICRs, testing and fault finding.

About Us

Are you NAPIT registered?

Yes, registration 76645. Our NAPIT certificates cover electrical installations and periodic inspection and testing in homes and other buildings, and self-certifying electrical installations in homes.

Are you insured?

Yes. Our insurance covers public liability up to £2,000,000, employers liability up to £10,000,000 and professional indemnity up to £1,000,000.

Do you guarantee your work?

Yes, with a 12 month guarantee. Ask us about it when you get your quote.

Who will do the work?

Scott Skinner and the team. There are 3 of us. More about us.

Which areas do you cover?

We're based in Crawley and cover Copthorne, Horley, Horsham, East Grinstead, Haywards Heath, Burgess Hill, Leatherhead, Cobham and Weybridge, and further out Tunbridge Wells, Sevenoaks and Dartford. See every area we cover.
